name: piping-toolset
description: ASME B31.1 / B31.3 piping skills from PipingToolset (pipingtoolset.com): pressure design, stress screening, CAESAR II / AutoPIPE load cases, PDF isometric to CAESAR II PCF, pipe support structural checks (AISC 360-22, ACI 318-19, ASCE 7-22) with review and optimization, equipment nozzle load evaluation (API 610 / 617 / 611 / 612 / 660 / 661 / 560 / 650, NEMA SM-23 form, PVP2011-57100 vessel default) and bolted flange evaluation (pressure-equivalent screen, then BPVC VIII-2 Part 4.16). No ASME or API code table values are embedded.
